about: THEME2 proposal (2026-10-28): the owner's balancing plan steps 1 (thematic) and 2 (winnowing), per map in road order, with the owner's 22:47 sizes (main maps 8-11 unique + 4-5 carried, 12-16; submaps 1-3 unique + 10+ carried, 11-14). Replaces THEME1 (kept as history). A proposal only: canonical/map-pools.json, cards.json and card-obtain-maps.json are unchanged. Built by tools/theme2_proposal_2026_10_28.py.
